rubric_notes: All must_include met: 2.08-stable, families a.22.1.1-4 under superfamily a.22.1 (SUNID 47113), fold a.22 (47112), class a; superfamily supplies the evolutionary inference while fold/class describe structure only. Family-level distinctions preserved; explicit statement that histone-fold homology does not establish DNA binding, nucleosome formation, partners or whole-protein function, with external evidence types named. Correctly uses bundle-supported bacterial-family duplication annotation and fold core comment. Linker histone a.4.5.13 lineage correct, with the balanced caveat that separate superfamily does not prove independent origin. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families a.204.1.2 (SUNID 116993) and a.204.1.4 (SUNID 140797), superfamily a.204.1 (SUNID 101386), fold a.204, class, release 2.08, protein names (HisE vs hypothetical SSo12199), and superfamily five-helix comment, all supported by the bundle. Correctly attributes the evolutionary assertion to the superfamily and not fold/class, rejects bidirectional transfer of substrate specificity, pathway role, metal requirements, oligomeric state and template interchangeability, and lists required external evidence. Complete. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-16.

All three family SCCS/SUNIDs, superfamily c.55.1/53067, fold c.55 and class correct and bundle-supported. Correctly distinguishes superfamily homology from fold-only similarity, infers an ancestral nucleotide-handling scaffold, and explicitly refuses transfer of substrate specificity, chaperone activity, filament formation, regulation, mechanism and templates, naming required external evidence. No material issues.

Complete and bundle-supported: stable release 2.08, correct family/superfamily/fold SUNIDs, superfamily as the homology-bearing level versus fold/class as structural only; uses fold and bimetal-centre annotations appropriately as shared framework, not shared mechanism; caveats on the RNR-like name and on R2 versus whole RNR; rejects transfer of storage, radical, catalase activity, metal preference, substrate, assembly; lists sequence/structural alignment, metal-site comparison, ligand-bound structures, assays, and phylogenetic evidence as required. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16. All must_include met: families b.6.1.1/b.6.1.5/b.6.1.6 with correct SUNIDs (49504, 74874, 110107) under superfamily b.6.1 (49503), fold b.6 (49502); superfamily-level homology stated and distinguished from fold/class; cites SCOPe family comments 'probably related to cupredoxins but lacking the metal-binding site' (verified in bundle) against the superfamily 'contains copper-binding site' comment; requires coordinating residues, metal-bound structures, redox/spectroscopic evidence. Notes PAD4 placement concerns only N-terminal domain. No must_avoid violations.

All identifiers correct and evidence-supported for stable 2.08. States superfamily placement supports ancestry while fold/class gives only structural similarity, and explicitly rejects transfer of covalent modifier/conjugation roles, Ras-binding specificity, and p97/VCP adaptor role across families or to every UBX member; notes needed external evidence and template caveats.

All family, superfamily, fold identifiers and SUNIDs correct for 2.08 and supported by parents/annotations/homology responses. Correctly separates structural fold/class from the superfamily-level evolutionary inference. Rejects transfer of aspartyl phosphorylation, phosphorelay, chemotaxis, clock role, decarboxylation and PLP binding; explicitly states the relationship concerns the N-terminal wing, not the entire enzyme or its catalytic machinery. KaiA 'lacks canonical receiver-domain features' comment and the d1r8ja2 'structured linker 136-176 in swapped dimer' annotation are both present in the bundle. Lists external evidence required. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

States b.84.5.1 / b.84.5 (310577) within b.84 (51229), class b, with instance d3a5ca3 3a5c A:113-184; names siblings; fold annotation supports architectural grouping but not ancestry; superfamily = probable common ancestry, family = closer grouping; separation does not assert ancestry nor prove independent origin; flags that API does not expose rationale and PMID 19893485 was not retrieved; rejects ATP-binding/catalytic/template transfer. All identifiers supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete. Correct SCCS/SUNIDs, class, fold annotation; superfamily comments accurately paraphrased from bundle and correctly used as caution rather than merger. Explicitly states separate superfamilies do not prove nonhomology; requires sequence/profile, structural alignment with heme-ligating positions, complex context, phylogenetic and biochemical evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct identifiers and hierarchy, supported by parents/annotations/homology endpoints. Distinguishes superfamily-level ancestry from fold/class structural similarity, explains functional diversification, refuses transfer of ADH activity, CoA binding, channel regulation and NAD/NADP preference, states the relationship concerns domains not whole enzymes/channels, correctly quotes the c.2.1.1 family comment, and lists required external evidence.

Meets all must_include: same family k.40.1.1 'Designed trimeric coiled-coil' (SUNID 100905), 'not a true family' comment, annotation blocks ordinary family-level homology inference. Correct domain SUNIDs 98768/61142, class k, fold k.40, nominal superfamily k.40.1. States limits both ways (not proof of nonhomology either), names required external evidence, rejects amyloidogenic/ligand/template transfer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met with correct identifiers: 1.69 d1t1ja_ (SUNID 106249) in c.137/c.137.1/c.137.1.1 vs d1f8ya_ (31395) in c.23/c.23.14/c.23.14.1; 2.08 d1t1ja1 in c.23.14.2 vs 1f8y in c.23.14.1 under shared c.23.14 (52309). Frames the change as gaining a SCOPe-supported probable-common-ancestry relationship while retaining separate families, notes that 1.69 separation did not prove independent origin, cites the superfamily active-site comment (supported by bundle), and clearly states limits (no substrate/reaction transfer; paper needed for rationale). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met with full l/l.1/l.1.1/l.1.1.1 lineage, SUNID 343393, H:1-8 boundary, and d1a14h1 H:9-111 in b.1.1.1 V-set/Immunoglobulin lineage. Correctly notes artifact groupings lack evolutionary meaning, cites the homology_implied_by_level=false warning (supported by bundle), rejects ancestry, function-transfer, and template use, recommends masking, and states the limit that tag chemistry/purpose cannot be inferred from SCOPe records. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Correct 1.75 single domain, correct 2.08 split classifications and boundaries; uses supported 1.75 fold comment on four regions. Strong homology/family-superfamily reasoning with limits stated. Dates first split to 2.06 (honestly caveated) rather than the actual 2.04.

All five domains correctly identified with SIDs, boundaries, SCCS, family and superfamily names; d3jb9a5 A:47-697 correctly given as the new fold d.394 with N-terminal placement. Cites family annotations (likely homology to endonuclease domains, homology to retroviral RT, linker included) that are supported by the bundle. Distinguishes reused modules from innovation, explains family vs superfamily vs fold homology semantics, notes that a new fold is not proof of de novo origin, declines function transfer, and lists required external evidence.

Directly answers with repeat architecture allowing single repeat or arrays, cites re flag on d2kq5a_/d3v6pa_, the 'single repeat' comment, and the 4cj9 A:259-292 representative as neither full boundary nor transferable. Correct homology gradient (family vs superfamily vs fold) and honest about missing exact counts.

Bundle-supported metadata (2.08, 2.08-stable, freeze/release dates, periodic 2.08-2026-08-16). Good citation guidance: use release-scoped selector 2.08 rather than the changing current endpoint, and preserve the full dated label when analyzing the update; states the periodic label does not replace the stable release. Omits the content meaning of periodic updates (new PDB entries added without rewriting stable-release domains). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include items met with bundle-supported evidence: shared a.47.2.1/t-snare/STAT-like lineage, verbatim three-helical fragment/spectrin comment and ms annotation, four-long-helix fold description, instruction to align fragments to the complete domain and not read missing elements as deletions. Correctly limits homology to family/superfamily, rejects spectrin and STAT function transfer, notes automated-match provenance is not a quality judgment, and states what the records cannot establish (historical rationale). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Contrasts c.2.1 (SUNID 51735, fold c.2, class c) with HMG-CoA reductase NAD-binding domain d.58.20.1/d.58.20 (SUNID 55035, fold d.58, class d); all identifiers verified in bundle. Explicitly states both that one ancestor is not established and that distinct superfamilies do not prove independent origin; notes external comparisons were not retrieved so convergence remains unverified. Hierarchy semantics, evidence integration, and transfer caveats complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Accurate 2.04 vs 2.08 hierarchy with SUNIDs, shared superfamily b.18.1 vs families b.18.1.36/b.18.1.3. Topology (9- vs 10-strand jelly-roll) and calcium-free N-terminal strand annotation used correctly; PMID 17977833 treated as a literature pointer, not an independently verified 1nqd-1dlc alignment. Clear statements of what cannot be inferred and no function transfer.

Complete: correct 2.08 SUNIDs and lineage; hf correctly defined and properly scoped (does not identify d1p7jd_ as the exemplar); both mutant comments noted; homology retained while fold/class alone not sufficient. Rejects equivalent helix packing/contacts/template use, requires alignment and coordinate inspection, stratify or exclude d1ztra1 for uniform-fold tasks, leakage controls. All supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Complete. Correct SUNIDs (107766, 103884), release 2.08, family/superfamily homology vs fold/class similarity, verbatim fr definition. Alignment: observed core only, mask absent positions, report coverage, do not compare fragment-based scores as if complete. Representative: prefer verified complete, adequately validated member; correctly reports 1o5d AEROSPACI 0.28747195 (X-ray 2.05 Å) vs 1uc6 0.02158265 (NMR) and notes quality does not restore coverage or measure homology; retain fragment with label. Diversity: separate incomplete observations from genuine variation; function-transfer caveat. All values match the evidence bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete: provisional new superfamily after confirming fold topology; family asserts probable ancestry with distinct family-level group; new fold requires distinct arrangement, lack of homology insufficient; explicitly a revisable evolutionary hypothesis with named evidence requirements; notes placement does not prove independent origin; correctly adds that the new superfamily needs its own family. Levels consistent with bundle. Function/template caveats included. No factual errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Release 2.08, family/superfamily/fold/class identifiers and SUNIDs (including class d 53931) verified in the bundle; fold annotation quoted accurately. Separates superfamily-based ancestry from fold/class structural similarity; mechanistic claims limited and caveated (activity not guaranteed in all members); rejects transfer of protein, aminoglycoside, and phosphoinositide specificity and of activation-loop, autoinhibition, and PI3K regulatory-subunit control; requires sequence/structural alignment, catalytic and substrate-contact residues, bound-ligand structures, kinetics, domain architecture, PTMs, partners, and cellular evidence. Transparently notes external data were not inspected. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-16.
